propositions: The store-wide compaction sweep spawns one git log --full-history child per ticket inside the store write lock, holding the lock for minutes and stalling all writers in the fleet.
The deployed sweep falls through to per-event wildcard git log walks when the per-ticket position map misses entries, with leading-wildcard pathspecs defeating pruning and causing full-history scans.
The _commit_backfill staging uses unscoped git add -A, allowing concurrent writers' in-flight event files to be committed under the compactor's message instead of only folded paths.

The sweep never re-yields mid-run; it probes write_lock_is_busy once before starting then loops through all tickets without re-checking, so writers arriving after the sweep starts wait for the entire run to complete.
The fix hoists the position-commit map build (one history walk per sweep) outside the lock and threads it through per-ticket folds, reducing critical section scope to SNAPSHOT write and renames only.
Scoped staging (git add -- <ticket_id>/) and mid-run re-yield (re-probe lock between tickets) eliminate theft of concurrent events and allow the sweep to stand aside when writers arrive.
